LESSON: LISTENING AND SPEAKING 6.1.1.CONVERSATIONAL SKILLS: NEGOTIATION SKILLS

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 6
Topic 6.1: Listening and Speaking 6.1.1.Conversational skills: Negotiation skills

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Listening and Speaking 6.1.1.Conversational skills: Negotiation skills
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: which people are negotiating or bargaining for 1. Which words or expressions would one use when negotiating?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. identify words and phrases used during negotiations
2. use verbal and non- verbal cues during negotiations

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Listening and Speaking 6.1.1.Conversational skills: Negotiation skills

• Listen to a model.
• Study the example.
• Then produce your own example.

▸ Listening and Speaking 6.1.1.Conversational skills: Negotiation skills

Teach
• Focus skill: identify words and phrases used during negotiations.
• Use complete sentences.
• Speak clearly; write neatly.

Worked example
• Model sentence 1 about Listening and Speaking 6.1.1.Conversational skills: Negotiation skills.
• Model sentence 2 using a Kenyan school example.
• Model dialogue: A: “…?”  B: “…”

Try this
• Write 5 original sentences on this skill.
• Say one 30-second oral example to a partner.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• One clear model for Listening and Speaking 6.1.1.Conversational skills: Negotiation skills
• One Kenyan school/home example

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences.
2. Do one oral practice with a partner.
3. Correct spelling/punctuation.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Revision sheet: meaning + 5 examples + 5 practice items.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. which people are negotiating or bargaining for 1. Which words or expressions would one use when negotiating?
2. How can one enhance their negotiation skills?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• Model first, then try.
• Use complete sentences.

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
